summary: Frontend-only Delta Moto site tested end-to-end. Hero, smooth-scroll nav (Home/Services/About/Contact all scroll to correct sections), carousel prev/next/dot controls, contact form validation (empty → 4 field errors + error toast; invalid email → email error; valid → success toast + form cleared), contact info (phone 514-331-2456, address 1678 Rue Beaubien, hours, embedded map iframe, IG & FB links), and mobile hamburger with 4 nav links all working. No console/page errors detected. Design matches spec (dark bg, gold accents, italic uppercase headings).
action_items: Minor: data-testid 'contact-phone' is used twice — on the phone <input> in the form AND on the <a> tel link. Consider renaming the form input testid to 'contact-phone-input' to avoid strict-mode selector ambiguity in tests.

Minor: data-testid 'nav-link-{home|services|about|contact}' is rendered twice on mobile (once inside the hidden desktop container, once inside the open mobile menu). Automated queries using is_visible on the testid will match the first hidden desktop instance. Consider suffixing mobile links with '-mobile'.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate data-testids for contact-phone (input + link) and nav-link-* (desktop + mobile) can break Playwright strict-mode queries.
DeltaWay autoplay uses setInterval which continues even when tab is hidden — consider pausing on visibilitychange or hover for accessibility.
Contact form has no aria-invalid / aria-describedby on erroring inputs; screen readers won't announce validation errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only build; no backend calls. Smooth scroll uses window.__lenis via useLenis. Section ids: home, services, about, contact. Duplicate data-testids noted above — prefer .last() for mobile nav-link and role/text selectors for phone.
